name: Victorian boot
summary: The ankle boot of Victorian dress. It has a kid or cloth upper, a row of buttons or a lace front, an elastic side gusset, and a small stacked heel.

philosophy.core_thesis: A Victorian woman covers the ankle, so the boot is the shoe of every day and the cloth upper shows the cut of the last.
design_principles: Cover the ankle: raise the shaft 12 to 20 cm above the heel.
Close the shaft with 8 to 14 small buttons, or with a lace front of 8 to 10 eyelets.
Set a 2 to 4 cm stacked heel under the waist of the sole.
Cut a narrow, slightly pointed toe on a last made for a left and a right foot.
Add a toe cap of patent leather or kid in a second colour for day wear.
Insert an elastic gusset of vulcanised rubber webbing in each side for a slip-on boot.
Stitch the sole to the upper by welt or by pegs; do not glue it.
anti_patterns: A bare ankle in town dress
A flat, round-toed shoe with a single strap
A heel taller than 5 cm on a day boot
Rubber and foam soles on a dress boot

silhouette.shape: A close boot that wraps the foot and the ankle, with a narrow toe and a small heel under a long skirt.
silhouette.line: A straight shaft from the ankle bone to the calf, a gentle arch, and a toe that points slightly.
silhouette.fit: Snug at the ankle, held by the buttons or the elastic gusset; the vamp grips the instep.
silhouette.proportion: Shaft height about 1.5 times the length of the heel to toe line of the vamp; heel 2 to 4 cm.
rules: Keep the boot narrow, so that the skirt hem hides all but the toe.
Place the buttons on the outside of the shaft, in a close row.
Make the toe cap and the heel in the same colour or in one contrast colour.
Wear the boot with a long skirt that clears the ground by 2 to 5 cm.

fabrics.rule: Use fine kid for the upper of a dress boot and wool serge for a walking boot with a leather toe cap. Use a leather sole. Rubber appears only in the elastic gusset.

methods: lasting over a wooden last for each foot
elastic gusset set into the side seam
stacked leather heel built in layers
construction.closures: A row of covered or metal buttons closed with a button hook; or a lace front; or an elastic side gusset with a pull tab.
construction.details: A patent toe cap, a stitched vamp seam, a cloth top in a contrast colour, and a lining of linen or kid.

surface.pattern: Plain leather in one colour; a perforated toe cap or a stitched pattern on the vamp for display.
surface.gloss: Kid and serge at 5–20 GU; patent toe caps at 70–90 GU.
surface.wear: A boot gains creases at the ankle and a scuffed toe with age. Clean polish keeps it neat, and a worn boot looks respectable but old.

palette.strategy: Black and brown leather, with a cloth top in grey or fawn and a patent toe cap.

processes: hand cutting of the upper from a pattern
making.scale: Bespoke from a bootmaker, then, from the 1860s, factory output with the sewing machine; 1851 shows one hand-made pair for each customer.
making.signs: A narrow last, even rows of buttons, a stacked heel and a clean welt stitch.

pieces.form: Kid button boot with a patent toe cap and a stacked heel
Elastic-sided boot with a serge upper and a leather toe cap
Laced walking boot with a calf upper and a hob-nailed sole
Black boot with a patent vamp and a cloth top
Embroidered house boot in serge with a small heel

evidence.title: Boots MET 66.101.68a-b CP2
evidence.credit: Excelsior Button & Boot, The Metropolitan Museum of Art

lineage.root: The first style of the shoe branch: earlier shoes come from the trade of the cordwainer, which this domain does not hold as a style.

emotion.target_response: A sense of propriety and neatness: a covered, tidy foot that shows care and a respectable household.

use_cases: a period costume brief for a Victorian film
a museum label for a 19th century boot
avoid_when: the brief wants an athletic or casual shoe
the brief wants a modern heel

modifiers.how: Lower the shaft to the ankle bone, lace the front, and use a Goodyear welt on a polished calf upper.
Remove the shaft, use a single strap, and use satin or kid with a thin heel.

ornament_level.note: Day boots are plain; evening boots carry embroidery or a cloth top.
